daily_report_items: FANUC's 21 August volume anomaly was a thin-liquidity repeat rather than a changed investment gate: the Frankfurt line closed at EUR 32.619998931884766 on 1,233 shares after a 6.96% measured-period decline. The retained issuer PDFs remained byte-identical, the EUR 29.104 buy-below level remained unreached, and Hold / Watch with allocation ineligibility remained supported. summary: Completed exactly one bounded FANUC quick check for the 21 August volume anomaly. The EUR 32.619998931884766 close was 6.96% below the 24 July period start, with a 2.16862403 volume z-score but only 1,233 Frankfurt shares traded. Fresh retrievals of both retained issuer PDFs matched their registered hashes, leaving the thesis, scenarios, catalysts, risks, and invalidation unchanged. The unchanged scenarios imply about 11.52% expected return, 8.64% confidence-adjusted return, 11.53% base upside, and a EUR 29.104 buy-below level that remains unreached. Hold / Watch and allocation ineligibility remain supported by unresolved downside-payoff, relationship, and thin-liquidity constraints. Because no material gate changed and the fresh baseline remains decision-capable, no full security review was enqueued and the operation intentionally left no agent-owned repository delta. No strategy, signal, order, allocation, execution, cash, portfolio, fill, performance, or accounting state changed.
